summary: LibreBooking is a web-based resource scheduling tool designed to help organisations manage reservations for shared assets like meeting rooms or equipment. It provides a mobile-friendly interface with extensible options for customising booking workflows. The application is built with PHP and packaged for containerised environments.
goodFor: It is a good fit for internal IT teams or office managers who need a self-hosted calendar system to coordinate shared physical resources across a team.
watchOut: Given its moderate community traction, you may encounter fewer third-party plugins or community guides compared to mainstream commercial alternatives.
deployNotes: As a PHP application deployed via Docker, you will typically need to provision persistent storage for user uploads and a separate database backend, alongside a reverse proxy to handle TLS.
